podcast.title: Pure Formation (1991)
podcast.body: Hailing from Vancouver, Pure was formed in 1991. "Like Rhymes with Orange, they were formed in 1991."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Pure Breakup (2000)
podcast.body: Pure officially disbanded in the year 2000. "Pure broke up for good in 2000."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Todd Simko's Death (April 2012)
podcast.body: Todd Simko passed away in April 2012 at the age of 45 due to suicide, following a long period of depression. He reportedly jumped into the Fraser River and drowned. "He died in April 2012 at the age of 45. It was a suicide following a long period of depression. It appears he jumped into the freezer river and drowned."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Early 1990s Prime Time Success
podcast.body: Pure was listed as one of the Canadian bands that gained "prime time" exposure and success in the early 1990s. "The early 90s were pretty amazing with a long list of Canadian bands getting a shot at prime time. We had moist, the watchman, lowest of the low, sons of freedom, grapes of wrath, rhymes with orange, pure Gandarva's limb lifter."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Hollywood Movie Soundtracks
podcast.body: Several of Pure's songs were featured on Hollywood movie soundtracks. "Couple of songs made it onto Hollywood movie soundtracks."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Jerry Harrison Production
podcast.body: One of Pure's albums was produced by Jerry Harrison, who is known as the keyboardist for Talking Heads. "One of them was produced by Jerry Harrison, the keyboardist for the talking hits."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Jordy Birch's Post-Pure Career
podcast.body: Singer Jordy Birch continued his career in music after Pure's breakup, notably with his project "Guilty About Girls" in 2008. "Singer Jordy Birch has stayed with music. He had a fantastic project called Guilty About Girls in 2008."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Juno Nomination (Best New Group)
podcast.body: Pure received a Juno nomination for Best New Group. "There was a Juno nomination for Best New Group."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Notable Opening Gigs
podcast.body: The band secured several significant opening performances during their career. "and they had some really big opening gigs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.title: Todd Simko's Post-Pure Career
podcast.body: Guitarist Todd Simko worked with Bif Naked and subsequently established a career as a producer and engineer. "Guitarist Todd Simko went on to work with Biff Naked before getting a series of gigs as a producer and engineer."
